cases.name: Receipt example 1
cases.text: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an artifact card from it and exile that card.

cases.name: Receipt example 2
cases.text: Target player reveals three cards from their hand and you choose one of them. That player discards that card.

cases.name: Receipt example 3
cases.text: Look at target opponent's hand. You choose an enchantment card from it. That player discards that card.

cases.name: Receipt example 4
cases.text: Look at target player's hand. You may choose a creature card from it. That player discards that card.

cases.name: Receipt example 5
cases.text: Target player draws two cards. Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a creature card from it. That player discards that card.

cases.name: Receipt example 6
cases.text: Target opponent reveals three cards from their hand and you choose one of them. That player discards that card. Target player reveals two cards from their hand and you choose one of them. Exile that card.

cases.name: Receipt example 7
cases.text: {X}{B}, {T}: Target player reveals X cards from their hand and you choose one of them. That player discards that card. Activate only as a sorcery.

cases.name: Receipt example 8
cases.text: Choose an artifact card in an opponent's graveyard, then that player chooses an enchantment card in your graveyard. You may return those cards to the battlefield under their owners' control.

cases.name: Receipt example 9
cases.text: Choose a creature card in an opponent's graveyard, then that player chooses a creature card in your graveyard. You may return those cards to the battlefield under their owners' control.

cases.name: Receipt example 10
cases.text: Target creature reveals three cards from their hand and you choose one of them. That player discards that card.

cases.name: Receipt example 11
cases.text: Target opponent reveals three cards from their hand and you choose one of them. That player discards those cards.

cases.name: Receipt example 12
cases.text: Look at target player's hand. You choose a card and exile that card.

cases.name: Receipt example 13
cases.text: Target opponent reveals three cards from their hand and you choose one of them. Exile that card. trailing

cases.name: Receipt example 14
cases.text: Choose a creature card in an opponent's graveyard, then that player chooses a creature card in your graveyard. You may put that card onto the battlefield under their owners' control.

cases.name: Receipt comparison
cases.text: Target player reveals three cards from their hand and you choose one of them. That player discards that card. If that player has more cards in hand than you, draw two cards.

cases.name: Chosen comparison
cases.text: Choose an opponent. If that player has more cards in hand than you, draw two cards.

cases.name: Receipt example 17
cases.text: Target player reveals a number of cards from their hand equal to three. You choose one of those cards. That player discards that card.

cases.name: Receipt example 18
cases.text: Target player reveals X cards from their hand, where X is five. You choose one of them. That player discards that card.

cases.name: Receipt example 19
cases.text: Target opponent reveals three cards from their hand. You choose one of those cards. That player discards that card.

cases.name: Receipt example 20
cases.text: You may pay {X}. If you do, target player reveals X cards from their hand and you choose one of them. That player discards that card.

cases.name: Receipt example 21
cases.text: You may pay {X}. If you do, target player reveals X cards from their hand and you choose one of them. That player discards that card. Draw two cards.

cases.name: Receipt example 22
cases.text: When this artifact enters, target player reveals three cards from their hand. You choose one of them. That player exiles it. If a sorcery card is exiled this way, you may cast it for as long as you control this artifact, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.

cases.name: Receipt example 23
cases.text: Target player reveals three cards from their hand. You choose one of their cards. That player discards that card.

cases.name: Receipt example 24
cases.text: Target player reveals three cards from their hand. You choose one of them. That player discards that card. junk

cases.name: Receipt example 25
cases.text: You may pay {X}. If you do, target player reveals X cards from their hand and you choose one of them. That player discards that card. junk

cases.name: Receipt example 26
cases.text: Target creature reveals a number of cards from their hand equal to three. You choose one of them. That player discards that card.

cases.name: Receipt example 27
cases.text: Target player reveals X cards from their hand, where X is three. You choose one of those cards. That player discards that card. Draw X cards.

cases.name: Receipt example 28
cases.text: When this artifact enters, target player reveals X cards from their hand, where X is the number of Elves you control. You choose one of those cards. That player discards that card.
